notes.title: Complete remake of the game
notes.notes:
Hello
Thank you for your kind support
So far the game's purpose was to make it easier for me to enter a university but now things have changed
I have attained greater skill and knowledge. No more poorly made 3d monsters and bosses. Please expect AAA quality models
Also this game will no longer be about clearing the same floor over and over again, now this game will be about exploring a randomly generated maze with an epic boss fight in the end. There will be many characters to choose from and RPG elements. 
Multi-player will be supported. With great replay ability since the maze is randomly generated.
I will make a Twitter this December and will post link here from there you can see the progress of the development.
Thank you for reading and for your time.
